import requests, os

api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b587ee340204072eed'
headers = {'x-api-key': api_key}

table_ids = {
    '97': 'f9cad7b01a4721350017ab9ce9731044',
    '98': 'f9cad7b01a472135e81f8bfec6b4abf2',
    '99': 'f9cad7b01a4721358e099cf6a46cc01d'
}

for strain, ds_id in table_ids.items():
    r = requests.get(f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{hist_id}/contents/{ds_id}/display', headers=headers)
    
    genes_up = []
    genes_down = []
    all_genes = []
    lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    print(f"\n=== Strain {strain}: {len(lines)-1} data rows ===")
    
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        fields = line.split('\t')
        gene = fields[0]
        all_genes.append(gene)
        try:
            lfc = float(fields[2])  # log2FoldChange is column 3 (0-indexed: 2)
            if lfc > 1.5:
                genes_up.append(gene)
            elif lfc < -1.5:
                genes_down.append(gene)
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            pass
    
    print(f"  All genes: {len(all_genes)}")
    print(f"  Up-regulated (LFC > 1.5): {len(genes_up)}")
    print(f"  Down-regulated (LFC < -1.5): {len(genes_down)}")
